How does it work?

Fíjate en la terminación y en los auxiliares.

✅ Affirmative (+)

Con I / you / we / they, usamos el verbo base.

I / You / We / They + verb

I play tennis on Saturdays.

They study English at school.

Con he / she / it, añadimos -s o -es.

He / She / It + verb-s

He watches TV after dinner.

❌ Negative (−)

Usamos don't o doesn't + verbo base.

I / you / we / they + don't + verb
he / she / it + doesn't + verb

We don't eat meat.

She doesn't walk to school.

¡Atención! Con doesn't, el verbo no lleva -s.

❓ Interrogative (?)

La pregunta empieza con Do o Does.

Do + I / you / we / they + verb?
Does + he / she / it + verb?

Do you play basketball?

Does he live near here?

En respuestas cortas: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.

💡 Recuerda: con he / she / it, la -s solo aparece en afirmativa. En negativa y pregunta, la lleva el auxiliar does.

Your turn!

Completa cada hueco. Si hay dos huecos, escribe las respuestas en orden.

1. Affirmative (+)

Escribe el verbo en presente simple afirmativo.

10 questions
1I ________ (get up) at seven on weekdays.
2My sister ________ (walk) to school.
3We ________ (have) lunch at home.
4Tom ________ (watch) cartoons after school.
5You ________ (study) English on Tuesdays.
6Mia ________ (go) swimming every Friday.
7They ________ (play) basketball at break time.
8My dad ________ (teach) science.
9I ________ (do) my homework after dinner.
10The dog ________ (sleep) in the kitchen.
Score: 0 / 10

2. Negative (−)

Completa con don’t / doesn’t y el verbo en forma base.

10 questions
1I ________ (not / drink) coffee.
2She ________ (not / like) scary films.
3We ________ (not / go) to school on Sundays.
4My brother ________ (not / play) the guitar.
5They ________ (not / eat) meat.
6The bus ________ (not / stop) here.
7You ________ (not / have) lessons in the afternoon.
8Jack ________ (not / watch) TV in the morning.
9My friends ________ (not / live) near me.
10Our teacher ________ (not / speak) French in class.
Score: 0 / 10

3. Interrogative (?)

Completa el hueco con Do o Does. Usa las pistas entre paréntesis.

10 questions
1________ (you / read) comics?
2________ (your mum / work) in a hospital?
3________ (they / walk) to school?
4________ (Ben / play) football after school?
5________ (we / have) English today?
6________ (the cat / sleep) on your bed?
7________ (your friends / like) pizza?
8________ (Anna / go) to dance class on Fridays?
9________ (I / need) a notebook?
10________ (your dad / cook) dinner?
Score: 0 / 10

4. Mixed practice (+ / − / ?)

Decide si la frase es afirmativa, negativa o interrogativa.

10 questions
1Sam ________ (play) tennis every weekend.
2________ your cousins ________ (live) in Madrid?
3I ________ (not / get up) late on school days.
4My teacher ________ (teach) English and French.
5________ your sister ________ (watch) the news?
6We ________ (not / have) lunch at school.
7The shop ________ (close) at six o’clock.
8________ you ________ (listen) to music in the evening?
9Leo ________ (not / do) his homework in the morning.
10My grandparents ________ (live) near the beach.
Score: 0 / 10
Consejo de examen: busca primero el sujeto. Después decide si necesitas -s, don't o doesn't, o si la pregunta empieza por Do / Does.
